live._comment: off | on_motion | always. Live view drains Blink batteries fast: continuous use flattens them in 1-3 days. Use 'always' only for mains-powered cameras.

cameras._comment: Empty 'enabled' means all discovered cameras. 'disabled' always wins. Names are matched case-insensitively.

ffmpeg._comment: hwaccel: leave empty for software, or set qsv / vaapi / cuda. Only affects decoding; publishing is a stream copy.
